7d761b018f3aa1e2e183879ac741db11.overview: An aged, wealthy trader plots with his servant to recreate a maritime tall tale, using a local woman and an unknown sailor as actors.

7da1031863b9d87290f7c92e1af85303.overview: Witek runs after a train. Three variations follow on how such a seemingly banal incident could influence the rest of Witek's life.

7dab1828d405301c45b60beb6890e5dc.overview: Brought back to life by an unorthodox scientist, a young woman runs off with a lawyer on a whirlwind adventure across the continents. Free from the prejudices of her times, she grows steadfast in her purpose to stand for equality and liberation.
7dab1828d405301c45b60beb6890e5dc.tagline: She’s nothing like you’ve ever seen.

7dba8b19fbfc5f6d889e31ad65f76c81.overview: While a diamond advocate attempts to steal a collection of diamonds, troubles arise when he realises he’s not the only one after the collection.
7dba8b19fbfc5f6d889e31ad65f76c81.tagline: A tale of murder, lust, greed, revenge, and seafood.
